film.title: The Coffee That Carries a Story
film.logline: Through the quiet ritual of preparing coffee, I discover that home is not only a place — it is the stories, values, and love passed from one generation to the next.

style.palette: warm amber, deep ochre, burnt sienna, soft gold
style.lighting: low golden-hour firelight, single candle or jebena-ember glow, shallow depth of field
style.suffix: cinematic still, 35mm film grain, warm amber tones, shallow depth of field, intimate Ethiopian interior

shots.image_prompt: Pre-dawn light filtering through a narrow wooden window onto a traditional Ethiopian earthen floor, a clay jebena coffee pot resting on glowing charcoal embers in the foreground, wisps of white smoke curling upward, deep shadow with one warm amber glow, cinematic still, 35mm film grain, warm amber tones, shallow depth of field, intimate Ethiopian interior
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push-in toward the glowing embers, smoke rising gently
shots.music_cue: music swells softly from silence; sparse masinko string note
shots.reason: Atmospheric hook establishing sacred quietude and the sensory presence of the jebena before any words are spoken.

shots.image_prompt: Cinematic wide establishing shot of a warm humble traditional Ethiopian countryside home at sunrise, thatch and timber roof, earthen plaster walls with morning sunlight, a small wooden doorway open with gentle amber firelight glowing from within, peaceful, poignant, 35mm film grain, warm amber tones, intimate Ethiopian interior
shots.motion_prompt: Very slow gentle push-in toward the open glowing doorway
shots.music_cue: underscore: quiet, sustained strings and gentle acoustic guitar
shots.reason: Ground the narrative in a physical sense of origin and warmth, expanding 'home' beyond simple architectural shelter.

narration_clips.narration_am: ቤት ማለት ግድግዳና ጣሪያ ብቻ አይደለም።
narration_clips.subtitle_en: Home is more than walls and a roof.

shots.image_prompt: A clay jebena coffee pot bubbling and steaming on glowing charcoal, tiny amber sparks, a woman's dark-skinned hands in a white netela fabric sleeve adjusting the pot, tight close-up, rich bokeh background of a dim Ethiopian room, cinematic still, 35mm film grain, warm amber tones, shallow depth of field, intimate Ethiopian interior
shots.motion_prompt: Slow zoom-in to the bubbling spout, steam rising into soft focus
shots.music_cue: underscore: gentle masinko melody, soft percussion enters
shots.reason: Intimate close-up showing the visceral sensory triggers of memory: the bubbling sound, rising steam, and familial hands.

narration_clips.narration_am: አንዳንድ ጊዜ ቤት የሚጀምረው በቡና ሽታ፣ በእሳት ድምፅ፣ እና በአንድ የታወቀ ድምፅ ነው።
narration_clips.subtitle_en: Sometimes, home begins with the smell of coffee, the sound of a fire, and a familiar voice.

shots.image_prompt: Elderly Ethiopian woman, grey hair visible beneath a white netela headscarf, seated cross-legged on a woven mat, gesturing gently with one hand while speaking, warm lamplight on her face, blurred traditional household items in background, cinematic still, 35mm film grain, warm amber tones, shallow depth of field, intimate Ethiopian interior
shots.motion_prompt: Slow rack focus from her hands to her face
shots.reason: Introduce the elder storyteller whose living presence connects ancestral history, labor, and perseverance.

narration_clips.narration_am: ቡናው ሲፈላ፣ ታሪኮች ይነገራሉ። ስለ ትናንት፣ ስለ ትጋት፣ ስለ ተስፋ።
narration_clips.subtitle_en: As the coffee brews, stories are told. Stories of yesterday, hard work, and hope.

shots.image_prompt: Young Ethiopian child, perhaps 8 years old, sitting quietly in the corner of a dim room, wide dark eyes watching off-camera with a serious expression, wearing a simple white habesha kemis, soft golden light from one side, cinematic still, 35mm film grain, warm amber tones, shallow depth of field, intimate Ethiopian interior
shots.motion_prompt: Very slow push-in toward the child's face
shots.reason: Capture the innocent child's perspective—absorbing lifelong lessons subconsciously before understanding their weight.

narration_clips.narration_am: እኔ በዚያ ጊዜ ትልቅ ትምህርት እየተማርኩ እንደነበር አላውቅም ነበር።
narration_clips.subtitle_en: Back then, I didn't know I was learning something important.

shots.image_prompt: Two pairs of hands in frame: dark-skinned elderly hands pouring steaming coffee from a clay jebena into a small sini cup held by younger hands, the coffee a rich dark brown, golden ember light glinting on the cup's rim, cinematic still, 35mm film grain, warm amber tones, shallow depth of field, intimate Ethiopian interior
shots.motion_prompt: Slow tilt down from the pouring stream to the cup being received
shots.music_cue: underscore: emotional swell, strings rise slightly
shots.reason: The physical and symbolic act of generational transfer: pouring coffee and sharing heritage across hands.

narration_clips.narration_am: አሁን ግን እረዳለሁ። ትውልድ የሚያስተላልፈው ነገር ቡና ወይም ታሪክ ብቻ አይደለም።
narration_clips.subtitle_en: But now, I understand. What one generation passes to the next is not just coffee or stories.

shots.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of a small traditional sini coffee cup held in both hands, the dark coffee liquid still, tiny wisps of steam, the cup's white porcelain with a delicate blue pattern, hands warm in amber light, cinematic still, 35mm film grain, warm amber tones, shallow depth of field, intimate Ethiopian interior
shots.motion_prompt: Locked-off, only steam moves; very gradual zoom-in
shots.music_cue: underscore: piano or krar note; held
shots.reason: Contemplative stillness centering the core philosophical definition: coffee ritual as patience, love, and identity.

narration_clips.narration_am: ትዕግሥትን፣ ፍቅርን፣ እና የራስን ማንነት ነው።
narration_clips.subtitle_en: It is patience, love, and a sense of who we are.

shots.image_prompt: Wide shot: a modern Addis Ababa apartment window in background showing blurred city lights and high-rises at dusk, but in the sharp foreground a clay jebena sits on a small gas burner on a kitchen counter, two ceramic cups beside it, a city person reconnecting with tradition, cinematic still, 35mm film grain, warm amber tones, shallow depth of field, intimate Ethiopian interior
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pull-back from the jebena to reveal the full window and city beyond
shots.music_cue: underscore: strings swell, more modern feel, bittersweet
shots.reason: Bridge past and present: showing the traditional jebena thriving within modern urban Addis Ababa life.

narration_clips.narration_am: ዓለም ቢቀየርም፣ እነዚህ ትዝታዎች ከእኔ ጋር ይቀጥላሉ።
narration_clips.subtitle_en: Even as the world changes, these memories stay with me.
One day, I will prepare the coffee too.

narration_clips.subtitle_en: And I will carry the story forward.
